run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T14:59:13Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a configuration-only rollout of the shipping Deployment at 2026-11-16T14:57:53Z–14:58:00Z. The new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 carries QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" where the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 had QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080" (same image tag). Shipping's get-quote handler now fails before any network call: in trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c the shipping server span /get-quote returns "Internal Server Error" and its only child, client span "POST ", errors in 10µs with "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))". That 500 propagates to checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (grpc code 13, otel.status_description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500") and then to frontend POST /api/checkout → HTTP 500, which is exactly the frontend error traffic the alert reports. Frontend error spans were zero from 14:33:13 through 14:58:13 and first appeared at 14:59:13; they are confined to the checkout path. Quote and email both stop receiving calls (last quote log "Calculated quote" at 14:57:57, 5-minute span volume 0 from 15:03 onward), consistent with the break occurring inside shipping before either downstream was reached. No node, restart, OOM, eviction or readiness problem was found: all otel-demo pods are Running and ready with 0 restarts.

claims.text: In the 20 minutes ending 2026-11-16T15:12:54Z, frontend error spans (status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) are confined to the checkout path: span_name POST 431.28, POST /api/checkout 431.28, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 431.28 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 431.28 (rpc.grpc.status_code 13); every other frontend operation in that aggregate shows 0 error spans.

Sampled frontend error spans are HTTP 500 on operation POST /api/checkout with span log exception.message "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", and the child grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span carries grpc.error_message with the same text and rpc.grpc.status_code 13.

Trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c shows the failing chain: frontend POST /api/checkout HTTP 500 -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error code 13 with otel.status_description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" -> checkout client span HTTP POST error being parent of shipping server span /get-quote with otel.status_description "Internal Server Error" -> shipping client span "POST " error with otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))" lasting 10 microseconds and no downstream span beneath it.

Jaeger lists exactly four shipping operations: server /get-quote, server /ship-order, client "POST " and client "POST quote" — the failing outbound call is shipping's own client span named "POST " (empty target in the name).
Deployment otel-demo/shipping (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, 1 replica ready) has container env QUOTE_ADDR set to "quote:0000".

The current ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 2026-11-16T14:57:53Z, owned by Deployment shipping, 1 replica) has QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000", while the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 2026-11-16T14:21:22Z, owned by the same Deployment, now 0 replicas) has QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080"; both use the identical image reference ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping.

Events in otel-demo show Deployment shipping scaled replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1 at 14:57:53Z and scaled shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0 at 14:58:00Z; pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn was Scheduled 14:57:53Z, container Created 14:57:58Z and Started 14:58:00Z, and pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q was killed and deleted by its ReplicaSet (SuccessfulDelete) at 14:58:00Z.

Only shipping has a ReplicaSet created after 14:30Z (shipping-5ffdc77bc8 at 2026-11-16T14:57:53Z); all other otel-demo ReplicaSets, including checkout-5dccddf8bb, email-59f69bc6cf, frontend-675fd7b5c5 and quote-6b5877698d, were created 2026-11-16T14:21:21Z–14:23:03Z.

Frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase was 0 at every 60-second step from 14:33:13Z through 14:58:13Z and first became non-zero at 14:59:13Z (71.11 over 5m), while checkout and shipping error increases are first non-zero at the step ending 15:00:13Z.

Quote service span volume fell after the rollout and stayed at 0: 5-minute increases 433.33 (14:59:00Z), 280 (15:00:00Z), 146.67 (15:01:00Z), 56.67 (15:02:00Z) and 0 from 15:03:00Z onward; the quote pod's newest log line is "Calculated quote" at 2026-11-16T14:57:57.125060Z.

Email service span volume dropped in the same shape (577.78 at 14:59:00Z, 373.33, 195.56, 75.56, then 0 from 15:03:00Z onward), and the 20-minute aggregate contains no email STATUS_CODE_ERROR series — all returned email spans (send_email, sinatra.render_template, POST /send_order_confirmation) are STATUS_CODE_UNSET.
All 21 otel-demo pods, including shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (created 2026-11-16T14:57:53Z), are phase Running with ready=true and restartCount 0 and empty lastState.

The newest 80 log lines of the shipping container in pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (spanning 15:04:34Z–15:06:54Z) contain only the repeated line "Requesting quote"; no error or exception lines were returned, and the container has no previous instance.
Deployment otel-demo/checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR="http://shipping:8080" and EMAIL_ADDR="http://email:8080", and Deployment otel-demo/email has EMAIL_PORT="8080"; neither shows a malformed address.

Deepest supported cause: the shipping rollout at 14:57:53Z–14:58:00Z changed QUOTE_ADDR from "http://quote:8080" to "quote:0000"; the resulting URI is unparseable, so shipping's get-quote handler fails with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) before any network call, returns HTTP 500, and that error propagates through checkout PlaceOrder (gRPC 13) to frontend POST /api/checkout (HTTP 500), producing the frontend error rate behind the RequestErrorRate alert.

Email service returning 500 is not supported as the cause: the failing span in trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c is shipping's outbound POST that never left the process (InvalidUri, 10µs, no child span), no email span appears anywhere in that trace, the 20-minute aggregate contains no email error-status series, and email's deployment config is well formed; the drop of email traffic to 0 is a consequence of checkout failing earlier in the flow.

Quote service failing is not supported as the cause: quote kept logging "Calculated quote" until 14:57:57Z and its spans carried no error status; its span volume fell to 0 only because shipping's malformed QUOTE_ADDR stopped shipping from calling it.

The error string propagated to checkout and frontend names the "email service" ("shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"), yet the only outbound call attempted under shipping /get-quote is a POST with an invalid URI and no downstream span; shipping's pod template exposes only QUOTE_ADDR, so the message wording does not match the observable failure point and is left unexplained rather than used to blame email.

Restore QUOTE_ADDR to "http://quote:8080" in Deployment otel-demo/shipping (the value the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 used) and roll the Deployment, then verify shipping /get-quote no longer returns "Internal Server Error"/InvalidUri, that quote-6b5877698d receives "Calculated quote" traffic again, and that frontend POST /api/checkout stops returning HTTP 500.

gaps: No alerting rule named RequestErrorRate and no alerting rules at all were returned by list_prometheus_rules (no_data for both rule_name=RequestErrorRate and type=alert), so the alert expression and its reported value 1.7777777777777777 could not be verified against Prometheus; the alert labels/annotations are taken only from the supplied investigation context.

Which downstream the error text "failed POST to email service" refers to could not be verified: no span for the email service (or any other downstream) exists under the failing shipping client span, and shipping's pod template defines only QUOTE_ADDR.

The previous shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q is already deleted, so its image digest, logs and metrics could not be compared with the new pod; the two ReplicaSet templates show the same image tag but digest equality could not be checked.
The email container produced no log lines at all in the query window, so email logs could not be used to confirm its runtime behavior.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what set QUOTE_ADDR to "quote:0000" and exactly when (before the 14:57:53Z rollout) is unknown.

kube_pod_owner and kube_replicaset_owner series and the metric http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no data in this target, so kube-state-metrics ownership series and HTTP server error-rate metrics could not be used; pod ownership was established instead from ReplicaSet specs and Events.
next_steps: Have a human with change access review the Deployment otel-demo/shipping manifest history to confirm when and why QUOTE_ADDR was set to "quote:0000".
After the fix, re-check shipping /get-quote server spans and the traces_span_metrics_calls_total STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for frontend, checkout and shipping to confirm the error series returns to 0.
Locate the actual RequestErrorRate alerting rule in the Alertmanager/rule backend (not present in this Prometheus) to confirm the exact expression and threshold used.
